title: Full-text screening OVERRIDE pass — structured output (v1, amendment PRE-010 override phase)
description: No $ref/$defs/maxLength (codex strict-schema requirement); additionalProperties:false on every object; every property listed in required. scripts/ft_override_run.py validates the returned JSON against this schema with one repair retry. Reviewer B stand-in: independent re-read of the full text, each decision field compared against the first-pass pre-fill and flagged agree/override with a page-cited quote.

record_id.description: Echo of the input record_id exactly as supplied.

disposition.description: Your own independent read, decided BEFORE comparing to the pre-fill.

disposition_quote.description: Format: p.N: "<=20-word verbatim quote" grounding your disposition, or "" if none applies (e.g. DUPLICATE_REPORT naming another record).

disposition_agreement.description: agree if your disposition matches the pre-filled your_disposition exactly; override otherwise.

primary_code.description: Non-empty only when disposition is EXCLUDE; the first established reason in hierarchy order. "" otherwise.

primary_code_quote.description: Format: p.N: "<=20-word verbatim quote" grounding the primary_code, or "" if primary_code is "".

primary_code_agreement.description: agree if your primary_code matches the pre-filled your_primary_code exactly (including both being ""); override otherwise.

age_rule_check.description: PRE-011 branches: adults_confirmed = adult by explicit range/min >=18y OR mean>=20y/adult-descriptor with no stated <18y participation; mean_minus_2SD_below_18_unresolved = unresolved age case under PRE-011 (mean <20y with no range, or age not reported, or a separable stratum's age unresolved) -- name which branch in the quote; under_18_included = report states <18y participants with no separable adult stratum; not_applicable = disposition is NOT_RETRIEVED/DUPLICATE_REPORT, or EXCLUDE already established on FT01/FT02.

age_rule_check_quote.description: Format: p.N: "<=20-word verbatim quote" supporting age_rule_check, or "" if not_applicable with no age text at all.

age_rule_check_agreement.description: agree if your age_rule_check branch matches the substance of the pre-filled your_age_rule_check (ignore cosmetic formatting differences, compare the branch/meaning); override otherwise.

validation_subtypes.description: Every applicable subtype under the v1.2 strict definitions; empty if validation_element_confirmed is no/unclear.

validation_quote.description: Format: p.N: "<=20-word verbatim quote" supporting validation_element_confirmed, or "" if no/unclear with no candidate text.

validation_agreement.description: agree if your validation_element_confirmed AND validation_subtypes match the pre-fill's substance; override otherwise.

secondary_notes.description: <=40 words. Other failed dimensions; the RETAIN_BACKGROUND failed dimension (normally FT04); for DUPLICATE_REPORT, the retained record_id; or any other material fact AWAITING_CLASSIFICATION names.

secondary_notes_quote.description: Format: p.N: "<=20-word verbatim quote" grounding secondary_notes, or "" if secondary_notes is "".

secondary_notes_agreement.description: agree if your secondary_notes carries the same substance as the pre-filled your_secondary_notes; override otherwise (including when you clear it to "" or add a note where there was none).

comment.description: <=40 words, free text, no personal data, no e-mail. Your own reviewer-facing summary of the decision for the final your_comment column; replaces the pre-fill's composite comment.

comment_quote.description: Format: p.N: "<=20-word verbatim quote" -- the single most decisive quote behind your overall decision.

comment_agreement.description: agree if your comment reaches the same substantive read as the pre-fill's comment (even if reworded); override if your reasoning differs.

note.description: <=30 words, free text, no personal data, no e-mail. Anything else useful for the human reviewer checking your work (e.g. OCR noise, cohort linkage, translation concern).
